That includes workspace and per-screen data: pass_start, cm_*, last_dir/pre_valid/pre_use/pre_view_*/col_fresh, compiled_call's self-modified operands, sky_main's per-screen state (sky_on &3169...) and helicopter 0's image sky_img0 (&317F -> &317C).
